stations.title: Customer
stations.say: Anything with moth in the band?

stations.title: Toolbar
stations.text: A search box and a genre menu.
stations.note: Nothing connects them to the list.

captions: The hold shelf works. Then a customer asks for a band with moth in the name.
Typing in the search box does nothing, so Noor scrolls the whole screen twice.
You wire the search, the genre menu and a count line, in three tasks.
Now the list narrows as you type and says plainly when nothing matches.
Same question, a straight answer in seconds. The list is worked out, never stored.
